title: Kissed Roasted Japanese Dum Ehomaki
description: A roasted, flaky, comforting Japanese dish featuring basil leaves and dum, Whole30-friendly and formed into ehomaki rolls.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, chopped basil leaves, green onions, sesame oil, coconut aminos, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Lay a Japanese dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder, starting from one end.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Place the ehomaki rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each roll.
Roast the ehomaki rolls in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the ehomaki rolls from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
